title: Scrapbook de Diario de Viaje Multilingüe: Collage de Recuerdos del Viaje a Chengdu
prompt: Generate a collage scrapbook-style Chengdu travel journal featuring personal itinerary and travel photos. Text annotations in three languages: Chinese, Korean, and English. Include iconic Chengdu elements like panda illustrations, spicy food drawings, traditional architecture sketches, polaroid-style photos, washi tape decorations, handwritten notes, stamps, stickers. Warm color palette with cream and pastel tones. Scrapbook aesthetic with layered paper textures.
